# Perch, vendored

Perch is the design system the dashboard is built on, by the author of this template, MIT
licensed with the rest of the repository. These are its tokens only. The dashboard's
components and its dark theme live in `dashboard/dashboard.css`, outside this folder, so
the tokens stay a clean copy.

`tokens/fonts.css` declares `@font-face` rules for the latin subsets of Archivo and
JetBrains Mono (both variable, weights 400 to 700) saved in `fonts/`, so the dashboard
works with no network. Both fonts are under the SIL Open Font License, see
`THIRD_PARTY.md` at the repository root.
